# Graph operations · vector

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### vector.edit

Apply ordered edits to retained SVG points, segments, attributes and hierarchy.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `vectorDocument` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned SVG hierarchy and retained editable path segments"} |
| Input | `edits` | `array<record>` | Required | {"items":"record"} |
| Output | `value` | `vectorDocument` | — | {"layout":"Versioned SVG hierarchy and retained editable path segments"} |

Guides: [guide](../vector-resources.md#use-vectors-in-a-graph)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe vector.edit --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### vector.fillMask

Rasterize one vector shape as a typed fill mask using its winding rule and the SVG viewBox.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `vectorDocument` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned SVG hierarchy and retained editable path segments"} |
| Input | `key` | `string` | Required |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `info` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- Bake one selected shape using its inherited winding rule and the chosen viewport.
- The mask describes geometric fill coverage. Use SVG export for stroke, gradient and clip styling.

Guides: [guide](../vector-resources.md#use-vectors-in-a-graph)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe vector.fillMask --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### vector.path

Sample a selected vector shape into existing Ink paths with an explicit curve tolerance.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `vectorDocument` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned SVG hierarchy and retained editable path segments"} |
| Input | `key` | `string` | Required |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `path` | — | {"minItems":2,"dimensions":[2,3],"finite":true} |
| Output | `contours` | `array<path>` | — | {"items":"path"} |
| Output | `info` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- Returns one sampled contour and all sampled contours separately. Sampling is independent of the retained SVG path data.

Guides: [guide](../vector-resources.md#use-vectors-in-a-graph)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe vector.path --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
